Ethereum Foundation Doubles Protocol Security Team, Warns AI Threats Are More Urgent Than Quantum Computing The Ethereum Foundation, said AI-driven security threats have become more urgent than quantum computing risks, with AI models discovering software vulnerabilities faster than humans can review them. The foundation has doubled its protocol security team and made defenses against AI and quantum threats its top priority. Its plans include replacing elliptic-curve cryptography with hash-based signatures for validators and wallets, alongside new blob commitments. The foundation warned that the overhaul would be harder than Ethereum's 2022 Merge and could delay other long-planned upgrades. — link
